title: Lottie
summary: Vector accents in the comic look, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: flat fills, thick ink outlines and hard shadows that pop in with an overshoot and boil. Impacts, balloons, stamps, marks and two looping print backdrops.

items.name: Pow burst
items.description: A red burst, a yellow one and a white star pop in turn over zoom lines, with sparks: impact, big news.

items.name: Star pop
items.description: A big star pops out of a white burst and throws six small stars outward: a win, a rating, a reward.

items.name: Lightning bolt
items.description: A bolt strikes down the frame and flashes where it lands: speed, power, a shock.

items.name: Smoke puff
items.description: A cloud bursts into puffs that scatter and vanish, leaving a star: poof, a reveal, a change.

items.name: Speech pop
items.description: A speech balloon swings out from its tail and three dots bounce inside: talking, typing, a reply.

items.name: Thought bubbles
items.description: Bubbles rise into a thought cloud where a star lights up: thinking, an idea.

items.name: Exclaim
items.description: An exclamation mark jumps up and a question mark drops in beside it: surprise, wait, what?

items.name: Check stamp
items.description: A green seal slams down with impact lines and a tick is inked across it: done, approved, correct.

items.name: Cross stamp
items.description: A red jagged seal slams down, a cross is inked on and it shakes: no, wrong, rejected.

items.name: Arrow zip
items.description: An arrow zips in stretched by its speed, trailing streaks and a puff, and snaps to rest: next, go, this way.

items.name: Heart thump
items.description: A heart beats twice a loop with ink tick marks on each beat: love it, a like, a pulse. Loops.

items.name: Zoom lines
items.description: Boiling zoom lines around a pulsing burst: a loud looping backdrop for a number or a word.

items.name: Halftone pulse
items.description: A screen of red and blue Ben-Day dots swelling in a diagonal wave: a quiet looping backdrop.
